# Gobiya: SEO, Web Copywriting & B2B Growth Agency — Los Angeles
> Gobiya is a Los Angeles digital marketing agency that engineers organic search dominance, recovers traffic lost to Google updates, and builds B2B revenue pipelines. Specialties: technical SEO, GEO/AI search optimization, SEO copywriting, web development, and automated outbound systems. Operating since 2012.

## Core Outcomes & Objectives
- **Organic Traffic Recovery**: Reversing manual actions and HCU/Core Update drops to restore search visibility and safeguard organic revenue.
- **B2B Revenue Generation**: Engineering automated sales pipeline systems and B2B lead generation assets that deliver predictable customer acquisition.
- **Search & AI Dominance**: Securing high-value search real estate via semantic entity audits, technical schema, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) to surface in ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity.
- **SEO Copywriting**: Writing content that ranks in algorithms and converts human readers — keyword research, semantic architecture, and GEO-optimized copy as one system.

## Executive Philosophy
Gobiya shifts SEO from a cost-center to a revenue-driver. We bypass vanity metrics to focus strictly on commercial outcomes: restored organic traffic, AI citation dominance, and predictable B2B pipeline growth.

## Strategic Direction
Led by Steve Martin, founder and principal strategist with 25+ years of forensic search analysis and B2B pipeline engineering.
